scope: Read-only security review of advisory authority, PAPER-only constraints, credentials, provider boundary, bounded input/output, persistence, error handling, and retry spacing.

evidence_items.result: Jev yields advisory structured outcomes without broker order parameters or submission calls.
Requests use a fixed HTTPS OpenRouter Decisions endpoint, reject redirects, send API key only in Authorization, and avoid raw response/error persistence.
Question/vocabulary counts, serialized request bytes, JSON depth, session ID, and response body are bounded; responses are locally validated.
Persistence uses typed/sanitized evidence and does not store raw provider bodies.
Provider/schema/timeout/persistence/instability failures fail closed to no_action or abstention; retries are capped and process-local spacing applies.
